hooks.text: 同时经营移动牌组与战斗牌组，用双牌组规划每一步
hooks.excerpt: Master two unique decks - one for movement and one for combat.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 用Relocate等位移卡调整站位，在牌局中绕开并智取敌人
hooks.excerpt: Use cards like Relocate to navigate the battlefield and outwit enemies.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 以金色与蓝色的集中配色呈现神圣与亵渎、光明与黑暗的对照
hooks.excerpt: With a focused palette of gold and blue, the game immerses players in the stark contrasts that define its world, its Godwoken, and their enemies.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 战斗场景中的角色辨识度不足

excerpts.excerpt: 每个角色都在六边形中，特别不是特别鲜明
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: 立绘如果能更好一点就非常不错了
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 动画卡牌与故事场景增强了氛围

excerpts.excerpt: the animated cards/story scenes give it a nice atmosphere
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 通关后缺少再次挑战的意愿

excerpts.excerpt: 打完后，让玩家觉得没有再次挑战的意向
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 流程约三至五小时，过短

excerpts.excerpt: The game can be completed in about three to five hours. On top of that, it's very easy and offers little to no challenge.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 游戏很容易，几乎没有挑战

excerpts.excerpt: The game can be completed in about three to five hours. On top of that, it's very easy and offers little to no challenge.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 无法获得本局已赚取的奖励和经验

excerpts.excerpt: You don't receive the rewards or experience (XP) you've earned.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 卡牌同时用于移动与攻击，使玩家持续权衡站位和牌组

excerpts.excerpt: you use cards to move around the map and to do attacks so you are always thinking both about positioning and using your deck correctly
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 六边形地图、移动卡和站位让战斗更有趣

excerpts.excerpt: The hex map, movement cards, and positioning make fights more interesting.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
